---
title: "Not Listed"
description: "A doc NOT draft, marked unlisted: true, used to check that it is still accessible by direct URI but excluded from lists/filter()/filterTree()."
unlisted: true
---
The content of a doc `unlisted: true`, not draft. It has to stay accessible by
direct URI, but excluded from any list (filter()/flatten()/filterTree())
unless it is filtered explicitly by id or uri.
